description: Homecoming email profile for Serenity Blooms boutonnieres. Favor close-up floral detail, wearable styling, handcrafted character, and simple ordering information.

composition_guidance.preferred_opening: Use a close or medium-detail boutonniere image where possible so the floral workmanship is immediately visible.
composition_guidance.product_emphasis: Emphasize fresh flowers, coordinated color, wearable scale, and handcrafted construction.
composition_guidance.local_business_emphasis: Keep the presentation personal and local rather than highly corporate or catalog-like.
